established: The signature is Ed25519 (RFC 8032, cofactorless; small-order and non-canonical public keys rejected) over the 47 bytes `"warrant-sig-v1:" || id_raw`, where `id_raw` is the 32-byte id.
residual: this record cites its witness cases and mutants and does not run them; CI runs the suites and tests/mutants.py before tools/claims.py check

cofactorless is the verification equation of the library (cryptography/OpenSSL): the five edge vectors (P-edge) witness it and no mutant of this package can change it; removing the weak-key check (M193) is caught by the vendored vector verify-sig/weak-key-00, not by P-edge, whose keys the library rejects on its own
